# WBUK (Whitebox UK)

> WBUK, which stands for Whitebox UK, is a UK hospitality consultancy, established in 2000 and based in Oakham, Rutland. We specialise in procurement and operational improvement and efficiency for hotels, restaurants, gastro pubs, care homes (aged care), private hospitals and catering companies across the United Kingdom.

WBUK is independent of suppliers. Our work helps hospitality businesses reduce costs, strengthen supplier relationships, improve processes and increase profit.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.wbuk.net/): overview, sectors served, Our Services and frequently asked questions
- [Procurement services](https://www.wbuk.net/procurement-services/): spend optimisation, tender management, maturity uplift and transformation, tech enablement and supplier development
- [Book a consultation](https://www.wbuk.net/book-a-consultation/): enquiry form for new clients

## Services
- Spend Optimisation: spend review, category strategies, supplier sourcing and savings tracking
- Tender Management: competitive tenders from market approach to contract award
- Maturity Uplift & Transformation: business analysis, strategy, process improvement and change
- Tech Enablement: independent technology sourcing and system optimisation
- Supplier Development: supplier risk review, continuity planning and relationship management
- Operational Support: management consultancy to improve efficiency, strengthen processes and increase profit

## Facts
- Name: WBUK is short for Whitebox UK (also written Whitebox UK Hospitality Consultancy)
- Established: 2000
- Based in: Oakham, Rutland, England
- Serves: the whole of the United Kingdom
- Sectors: hotels, restaurants, gastro pubs, aged care providers, private hospitals, catering companies
- Email: customerservice@wbuk.net
- Contact: use the Book a consultation form at https://www.wbuk.net/book-a-consultation/
